Class.summary: Controller responsible for managing logged work hours and time entries on support tickets.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The service used to obtain the current authenticated user's ID and role.

GetTimeEntries.summary: Retrieves all time logs and the total duration recorded for a specific ticket.
GetTimeEntries.remarks: Restricted to Administrators and the Support Agent assigned to the ticket. Customers are not permitted to view time entries.
GetTimeEntries.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the ticket.
GetTimeEntries.returns: A list of individual time log entries along with cumulative total logged minutes.
GetTimeEntries.response: Returns the time entry logs for the ticket.
If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is a customer or not assigned to the ticket.
If the ticket does not exist.

AddTimeEntry.summary: Logs a new work duration entry for a specific ticket.
AddTimeEntry.remarks: Only the Support Agent currently assigned to the ticket can log work time.
AddTimeEntry.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the ticket.
The time entry payload (work date, duration in minutes, and work description).
AddTimeEntry.response: If the request payload fails validation (e.g. duration <= 0).
If the user is not authenticated.
If the caller is not the assigned support agent.
If the ticket does not exist.
